effects: Volatile direct application and historical explosion center

cells.normalized_text: Finishers inflicting Volatile to enemies within ? metres. Killing Volatile Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after being dealt 190 [200] damage or upon dying, dealing up to 145 [80] Void Ability Damage in a 5 meter radius. Volatile lasts for 10 [6] seconds, harmlessly expiring afterwards. Debuff is removed after triggering the explosion. The damage from the hit that applies Volatile doesn't count towards the detonation threshold. Incurs a 1 second cooldown before Volatile can be reapplied to an enemy after the explosion is triggered.

sources.finding: Finishers apply Volatile around the completed target and volatile kills create Void Breaches. Radius is explicitly unknown; this older entry provides no standalone burst damage value.

sources.short_excerpt: Finisher final blows create a burst of Void damage that causes nearby enemies to become volatile.
sources.finding: 2023-02-27 introduction ties the effect to finisher final blows and separately grants Void Breaches on defeating volatile targets. This supports the confirmed-completion trigger, not a current radius or damage calibration.

implemented: Actual confirmed finisher history supplies the victim position; nearby current non-allies receive world-authorized shared Volatile with actual combatant/Guardian duration classification.
Only the confirmed completion triggers the spread: start, cancellation, nonlethal strikes and death prevention do not qualify. New effects do not invent an extra damaging hit.
Current holder kills use historical Volatile and position, independent of who first applied it; shared Breach generation and actual collection feed Starvation/Devour and the current Class account.
Independent bounded finisher/death receipts survive source rebind and pure-session checkpoints; subsequent independent actual finishers and kills remain allowed.

All three existing Volatile explosion branches prefer the captured impact/death position, so a removed corpse no longer invalidates an observed center. Explicitly unavailable positions do not fall back to the live entity; only unobserved legacy hosts retain live lookup.
gaps: 正式Fragment/子职业装配与完整终结技目标资格、动画和伤害政策仍待接入；20%HP、3块选取距离、0.3秒和1000点终结技伤害是合成验收输入。
原表与固定Clarity均未给爆发半径，burst_radius必填且测试4米只验证闭边界。官方描述提到Void伤害爆发，但未找到独立伤害量，当前只施加共享Volatile，不将缺少伤害动作等同于原作无伤害；独立爆发伤害与视线/距离锚点政策待校准。
按终结技确认时当前Fragment装配触发、目标共享Volatile保留首次来源与截止时间、排除施放者/终结目标、缺失历史位置不补造中心，均为明确内容政策。完整换装/死亡时序与D2敌我例外仍需校准。
共享Volatile直接施加按实际Guardian/战员选择6/10秒，但既有命中生产者的全局环境阈值/爆炸伤害、0.1投影、线性衰减、Absorption与全部来源信用仍有原有缺口。
finisher_ids/death_ids仅在必填receipt_seconds窗口内有限去重；十二秒验收窗口不是额外游戏冷却，不阻止独立新击杀/因果链，也不保证无限期重放幂等或物理世界故障恢复。
Void Breach复用私有副本和五秒成功生成冷却；职业回能归一化与接触半径仍是显式测试输入。完整多人拾取政策、真实素材/HUD以及跨维度/物理世界重启仍未完成。
